page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfg6.8xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by the Intel Xeon 8269CY processor running at a base frequency of 3.1 GHz. This instance features 32 dedicated physical cores with a single thread per core configuration, delivering a total of 32 vCPUs. It is equipped with 128.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced allocation of 4.0 GB of RAM per core. The instance operates on the KVM hypervisor and includes a baseline network bandwidth of 10 Gbps. It does not contain any local storage or integrated GPU hardware, requiring external block storage for operating system and data volumes.

In benchmark evaluations, the instance demonstrates mid-range performance characteristics. The dedicated Intel Xeon processor achieves a stress-ng single-core score of 1436.68 and a multi-core score of 30666.35. Memory performance tests show a read-only small block cached bandwidth of 1705.41 GB/sec, which drops to 109.89 GB/sec for uncached large block reads, alongside a write bandwidth of 48.22 GB/sec. Geekbench testing yields a single-core score of 1287.0 and a multi-core score of 11107.0, with software compilation scoring 23704.0. Database operations via Passmark score at 11442.59, while Redis SET operations reach 28.91 million operations per second.

The lack of local storage and GPU acceleration represents a primary architectural tradeoff, limiting the instance to workloads that rely on network-attached storage and CPU-only execution. From a cost-efficiency perspective, the dedicated core allocation and 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio offer a stable resource density for general-purpose workloads without the risk of multi-tenant CPU contention. This profile is suitable for multi-threaded applications, software compilation, static web serving, and moderate database operations. It can also handle small to medium language model inference, processing 135M parameter models at 85.62 tokens per second and 7B parameter models at 12.4 tokens per second for text generation.
